prompt: A simple monochrome exam-style diagram showing two horizontal cylinders representing electrical wires, arranged one above the other. The top cylinder is Wire X. The bottom cylinder is Wire Y, and it must be drawn visibly longer and thicker (larger diameter) than Wire X. Label 'X' placed just outside to the left of the top cylinder. Label 'Y' placed just outside to the left of the bottom cylinder. Illustrative only, not answer-bearing. Simple monochrome exam diagram on a pure white #FFFFFF background. Clean black vector-like lines, flat 2D orthographic side-profiles (rectangles with slightly curved ends). Times New Roman-like serif font for labels. No measurement arrows, no extra labels, no shading, no unrequested arrows or symbols, no clutter.
negative_prompt: Pure white background only; no grey paper, gradient, or texture. No extra labels. No overlap. No sans-serif fonts. No decorative shading. No photorealism. No colour unless explicitly requested. No exact answer-bearing measurements. No clutter. No malformed symbols. Do not place objects in the wrong support/location relationship. No medium label pointing at objects inside the medium. No unrequested arrows, force labels, field symbols, construction arcs, or explanatory overlays.

must_show_relations: Wire Y is positioned below Wire X
relative_size_constraints: Wire Y must be visibly longer than Wire X
Wire Y must be visibly thicker than Wire X

hard_constraints: Wire Y must be visibly longer and thicker than Wire X
background must be pure white #FFFFFF with no grey fill or gradient
no unrequested arrows, force labels, field symbols, or construction arcs
